description: What is already on this machine, before anything is proposed.

beside.description: Where each service would listen to run beside the existing setup.

carrying.description: What adopting each recognised service would come to, by service name.

conflicts.description: Ports wanted by lemonfiber that an existing service already holds.

linking.description:
What the existing layout costs where it cannot hold a hardlink, absent where
it can.

modes.description: What may be done about what was found, least destructive first.

not_carried.description: What no migration carries across, whatever mode it runs in.

read.description:
Whether the engine answered at all.

False means the survey found nothing because it could not look, which is a
different answer from finding nothing, and the only one that must never be
read as an empty machine.

unsupported.description: What was found and cannot be adopted.
